articles.headline: Chelsea to play Women's Champions League, cup matches at Cherry Red Records Stadium
articles.description: Chelsea will play all cup matches, including Women's Champions League group matches at AFC Wimbledon's Cherry Red Records Stadium.

images.name: Laurens: Alexia Putellas' potential move to the WSL would be great for the league
images.caption: Julien Laurens and Gab Marcotti discuss Alexia Putellas leaving Barcelona after 14 years at the club and her potential move to the WSL.

articles.headline: Chelsea did what Chelsea do to beat Man United to League Cup trophy
articles.description: Chelsea needed two errors from Manchester United's defense, but they held firm to win the League Cup and add more silverware to their cabinet.

images.name: Lauren James of Chelsea celebrates scoring her team's first goal with teammate Alyssa Thompson  [1296x729]
images.caption: Lauren James of Chelsea celebrates scoring her team's first goal with teammate Alyssa Thompson
images.credit: Morgan Harlow - WSL/WSL Football via Getty Images

images.name: Chelsea beat Man United in Women's League Cup final
images.caption: Lauren James and Aggie Beever-Jones score to give Chelsea a 2-0 win over Man United the Women's League Cup final.

articles.headline: Chelsea's Sonia Bompastor eager to win silverware, part of club's 'DNA'
articles.description: Sonia Bompastor hopes Chelsea can reap more success when they face Manchester United in Sunday's Women's League Cup final at Ashton Gate.

articles.headline: Man United without Ella Toone and Anna Sandberg for Chelsea League Cup final
articles.description: Manchester United will be without Ella Toone and Anna Sandberg for the League Cup final against Chelsea on Sunday, manager Marc Skinner confirmed.

articles.headline: Why Chelsea, Man United need League Cup success -- and how they can do it
articles.description: Chelsea take on Manchester United in the League Cup final on Sunday, but both teams need to win for different reasons.

images.name: Chelsea's Naomi Girma celebrates after scoring their second goal during the Adobe Women's FA Cup fifth round match  [1296x729]
images.caption: Chelsea's Naomi Girma celebrates after scoring their second goal during the Adobe Women's FA Cup fifth round match
images.credit: Ben Whitley/PA Images via Getty Images

articles.headline: Chelsea successfully defend Women's League Cup after beating Man Utd
articles.description: Goals from Lauren James and Aggie Beever-Jones helped Chelsea retain the Women's League Cup with a 2-0 victory over Manchester United at Ashton Gate.

images.name: Chelsea beat Man United in Women's League Cup final
images.caption: Lauren James and Aggie Beever-Jones score to give Chelsea a 2-0 win over Man United the Women's League Cup final.
